answer: Prism table bond: each identity stakes 60 and files a prism table for its knoll plot on the island ledger. Peers recompute it from the island beacon; a miss burns the bond. Duplicate knoll plots share one table, so copies earn nothing. 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 x 100 = 100,000, far above the 40,000 pool; a rented-table ring fails because a table under another key never recomputes. Honest agents file once for 40 and reclaim 60 after a clean epoch.
